latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Free Video Producer.
- Easily turn raw MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM footage (up to 500MB) into polished 1080p MP4 videos using cloud GPUs.
- No paid software needed — get finished videos in 1–2 minutes per clip.
- Supports video trimming, text overlays, background music, and multiple export options.
- Handles all backend setup and session management automatically for a smooth, user-friendly experience.
- Built-in error handling and progress updates during video processing and export.
